title: Implement consumed-template tracking with shared index pool, atomic generation, and admin reset controls

requirements.text: Add a stable `availablePoolByList` HashMap (keyed by listId, value is a stable array of available template indices [Nat]) to the Motoko backend actor. On list creation, initialize the pool to [0, 1, 2, ..., N-1] where N is the number of templates. On template addition, append the new index to the pool. On template deletion, remove that index from the pool. Persist this structure across upgrades via preupgrade/postupgrade hooks into a stable array.

quotes: Maintain an AVAILABLE INDEX POOL per list: availablePoolByList[listId] = [0..N-1] at creation/import time

acceptanceCriteria: availablePoolByList is declared as stable storage and survives canister upgrades
Creating a new list initializes its pool to indices [0..N-1]
Adding templates to an existing list appends new indices to the pool
Deleting a template removes its index from the pool

requirements.text: Replace the existing `generateComment(listId, deviceId)` backend method with an updated atomic version that consumes from the shared `availablePoolByList`. Steps: (1) check claims HashMap for composite key `listId#deviceId` — if found, return `#err('Already generated on this device for this list')`; (2) get `availablePool = availablePoolByList[listId]`; (3) if pool is empty, return `#err('No comments left for this list')`; (4) randomly select one index from the pool; (5) remove that index from the pool; (6) persist updated pool; (7) insert claim into claims HashMap; (8) return `#ok` with the template text (suffix appended if present) plus metadata: `{ comment: Text, availableBefore: Nat, availableAfter: Nat, totalTemplates: Nat }`.

quotes: Get availablePool = availablePoolByList[listId]
Pop/remove allowedCount indices from availablePool
Insert claim for (listId, deviceId)

acceptanceCriteria: Returns already-claimed error if the device has already generated from this list
Returns out-of-comments error if the pool is empty
Removes exactly one index from the pool atomically in a single update call
Returns availableBefore, availableAfter, and totalTemplates in the response
Template text is returned with suffix appended if present

requirements.text: Replace the existing `generateBulkComments(listId, requestedCount, accessKey)` backend method with an updated atomic version that consumes from the shared `availablePoolByList`. Steps: (1) validate access key — if invalid, return error; (2) get `availablePool = availablePoolByList[listId]`; (3) if pool is empty, return error 'No comments left for this list'; (4) compute `allowedCount = Nat.min(requestedCount, availablePool.size())`; (5) randomly shuffle or randomly pick `allowedCount` indices from the pool; (6) remove those indices from the pool; (7) persist updated pool; (8) return the selected template texts (suffix appended) plus metadata: `{ comments: [Text], generatedCount: Nat, availableBefore: Nat, availableAfter: Nat, totalTemplates: Nat }`. No device lock is applied for bulk generation.

quotes: Bulk Generator: no device lock, only: valid access key, max count ≤ available templates, consumes from shared pool
allowedCount = min(requestedCount, availableCount)
Pop/remove allowedCount indices from availablePool

acceptanceCriteria: Returns error if access key is invalid
Returns error if pool is empty
Clamps returned count to availablePool.size()
Removes exactly allowedCount indices from the shared pool atomically
Returns generatedCount, availableBefore, availableAfter, and totalTemplates in the response
No device lock check is performed

requirements.text: Update `getAvailableCount(listId: Text) : async Nat` to return `availablePoolByList[listId].size()` (the current pool size) instead of computing from used indices. Update `getListMetrics() : async [ListMetrics]` to derive `availableTemplates = availablePoolByList[listId].size()` and `usedTemplates = totalTemplates - availableTemplates` for each list, where `totalTemplates = templatesByList[listId].size()`. percentUsed = usedTemplates / totalTemplates * 100 (0.0 if totalTemplates is 0).

quotes: getListMetrics and getAvailableCount updated to read from availablePool size

acceptanceCriteria: getAvailableCount returns pool.size() for the given list
getListMetrics returns availableTemplates derived from pool size
usedTemplates = totalTemplates - availableTemplates in metrics
percentUsed is 0.0 when totalTemplates is 0

requirements.text: Add a `resetPool(listId: Text, clearClaims: Bool) : async Result<(), Text>` update method to the Motoko backend. When called: (1) restore `availablePoolByList[listId]` to `[0, 1, ..., N-1]` where N = `templatesByList[listId].size()`; (2) if `clearClaims` is true, remove all entries from the claims HashMap where the key starts with `listId#`; (3) append an audit log entry recording the reset action, listId, clearClaims flag, and a timestamp. Return `#ok(())` on success or `#err(message)` if the list does not exist.

quotes: Add Reset Pool in Admin > Comments per list: Restores available pool back to full [0..N-1], Clears 'used' state for that list
Reset + Clear Claims (optional) — Clears device locks too

acceptanceCriteria: resetPool restores the available pool to full [0..N-1]
When clearClaims=true, all device claims for that list are removed from the claims HashMap
When clearClaims=false, device claims are preserved
An audit log entry is recorded with listId, clearClaims flag, and timestamp
Returns error if listId does not exist

requirements.text: Add a stable audit log array to the Motoko backend (e.g., `stable var auditLog: [(Text, Int)] = []`) that records entries as `(description: Text, timestamp: Int)`. The `resetPool` method must append an entry such as `'Reset pool for list [listId], clearClaims=[true/false]'` with the current time. Expose a query `getAuditLog() : async [(Text, Int)]` returning the full log.

quotes: with confirmation + audit log entry

acceptanceCriteria: auditLog is stable and survives upgrades
resetPool appends a descriptive entry to the audit log
getAuditLog returns all audit entries as (description, timestamp) pairs

requirements.text: In `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts`, update the `generateComment` mutation to: (1) pass `deviceId` from localStorage, (2) handle the response metadata (`availableBefore`, `availableAfter`, `totalTemplates`) and expose it to the caller, (3) after a successful generation immediately update the local available count state using `availableAfter` from the response, and (4) trigger a refetch of `getListMetrics` and `getAvailableCount` for the affected list. Update the `generateBulkComments` mutation to: (1) handle the `generatedCount`, `availableBefore`, `availableAfter`, and `totalTemplates` metadata in the response, and (2) trigger a refetch of `getListMetrics` and `getAvailableCount` after generation.

quotes: After successful generate, immediately update UI counts using response.availableAfter
Also refetch metrics to keep admin/user views consistent

acceptanceCriteria: generateComment mutation receives and exposes availableAfter from response
generateBulkComments mutation receives and exposes generatedCount and availableAfter
Both mutations invalidate/refetch getListMetrics and getAvailableCount after success

requirements.text: In `frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx`, update the Single Comment Generator section so that after a successful `generateComment` call: (1) the 'Available Comments' count displayed immediately reflects `response.availableAfter` without waiting for a separate query refetch; (2) if the response indicates the pool was empty (out-of-comments error), show the 'Out of comments' badge; (3) the device lock notice appears immediately using the localStorage claim stored after generation.

quotes: After generation, available count must reduce immediately: availableAfter = availableBefore - X
Frontend: immediate UI count update from response.availableAfter

acceptanceCriteria: Available Comments count updates immediately after generation using availableAfter from response
Out-of-comments badge appears when no pool entries remain
Lock notice is shown immediately from localStorage claim without extra backend round-trip

requirements.text: In `frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGenerator.tsx`, update the component so that: (1) after a successful generation, the 'Available Templates' label updates immediately using `response.availableAfter`; (2) if the backend clamps the count (generatedCount < requestedCount), display a toast notification: 'Only X available, generated X.' where X = generatedCount; (3) if availableAfter is 0 after generation, disable the Generate button and show 'Out of comments'.

quotes: If requestedCount > availableTemplates: clamp to availableTemplates and show toast: 'Only X available, generated X.'
If list has 0 available: show 'Out of comments'

acceptanceCriteria: Available Templates label updates immediately to availableAfter after successful bulk generation
Toast notification shown when generatedCount < requestedCount
Generate button disabled and 'Out of comments' shown when pool is empty after generation

requirements.text: In `frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.tsx`, add a Reset Pool control per comment list in the Manage Comments section. Display two buttons per list: (1) 'Reset Pool' — restores available indices to full, does not clear device claims; (2) 'Reset Pool + Clear Claims' — restores pool AND removes all device claims for that list. Both buttons must show a confirmation dialog before executing. On confirmation, call the `resetPool` backend mutation. After success, show a success toast and refetch list metrics and available count.

quotes: Add Reset Pool in Admin > Comments per list
Reset Pool + Clear Claims (optional) — Clears device locks too
Both require confirmation dialog, and an audit log entry is recorded

acceptanceCriteria: 'Reset Pool' button appears per list in Admin > Comments
'Reset Pool + Clear Claims' button appears per list in Admin > Comments
A confirmation dialog is shown before either reset action executes
On success, list metrics and available count are refetched
A success toast is shown after reset completes

requirements.text: In `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts`, add a `useResetPool` mutation hook that calls the `resetPool(listId, clearClaims)` backend method and invalidates `getListMetrics` and `getAvailableCount` queries on success.

quotes: Admin resetPool(listId, clearClaims) method

acceptanceCriteria: useResetPool mutation hook calls backend resetPool with listId and clearClaims boolean
On success, getListMetrics and getAvailableCount queries are invalidated/refetched

constraints: Do not break existing stable storage — all new stable variables must be added alongside existing ones with proper preupgrade/postupgrade hooks
Single Comment Generator device lock (claims HashMap) must remain intact and only be cleared when clearClaims=true is passed to resetPool
Bulk Comment Generator must NOT apply device lock — only access key validation
Both generateComment and generateBulkComments must draw from the same shared availablePoolByList per list
All pool mutations must be atomic within a single update call — no intermediate awaits that could cause race conditions
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Separate per-feature pools (Single vs Bulk do not get independent pools)
Any external AI or third-party API integration
Changes to the Live Checker, Admin Images, Admin Chat, or Admin Settings tabs
